features.title: Pure Concentrated Fragrance Oils
features.text: Extracted in Grasse & international ateliers, our high-purity oils and absolutes deliver unmatched sillage and longevity for perfume compounding.

features.title: Precision Glass Flacons
features.text: Heavy crystal bases, custom mold designs, and lead-free glass engineered specifically for premium fragrance housing.

features.title: Leak-Proof Spray Pumps & Caps
features.text: Micro-mist fine atomizers paired with luxury magnetic caps and weighted Zamak alloy closures for flawless seal and elegant luxury feel.

features.title: Global B2B Logistics & Low MOQ
features.text: Flexible bulk ordering, fast custom sampling, and white-glove international freight tailored for perfume brands and retail distributors.

milestones.title: Grasse Atelier & Mold Lab
milestones.text: Founded as a specialized glass blowing and perfume formulation lab in Grasse, supplying niche European perfumers with custom flacons.

milestones.title: Automated Bottle & Pump Line
milestones.text: Expanded production capacity to include high-precision 15mm crimp atomizers, leak-proof spray pumps, and weighted magnetic caps.

milestones.title: Dubai Logistics Hub
milestones.text: Established our Middle East free-zone distribution center to supply regional perfume brands with empty bottles, caps, and bulk oils.

milestones.title: Custom OEM/ODM Perfume Line
milestones.text: Launched end-to-end private label solutions—enabling brands to choose empty bottles, match caps & pumps, and select raw oils in one seamless process.

milestones.title: Maison Étoile Factory Atelier
milestones.text: Opened our state-of-the-art automated manufacturing facility, producing over 10 million flacons and supplying 500+ global perfume brands.

values.title: Raw Material Excellence
values.text: We source 100% pure concentrated fragrance oils and French absolutes, guaranteeing high stability and rich sillage for perfume formulation.

values.title: Glass Molding Mastery
values.text: Our flacons feature ultra-clear crystal glass, heavy bases, and precision 15mm crimp finish to ensure structural integrity and luxury aesthetics.

values.title: Seamless B2B Supply Chain
values.text: From small batch artisan sampling to full container shipments, our global logistics network delivers components with guaranteed quality compliance.

values.title: Custom Brand Engineering
values.text: We partner with perfume creators to design custom glass molds, unique cap finishes, custom pumps, and signature scent blends.
